manifest.full_instruction: Compare the requested requirements against the recorded set. A new requirement or removal is refine; repeating an existing requirement or negating a new addition is continue. Return JSON with transition, description (complete updated objective), and requirement_delta containing retained, added, removed arrays. Copy retained/removed entries exactly from the current set. Name additions with concise noun phrases using the request's wording. Preserve all unremoved requirements. Continue has no additions or removals; refine must change the set.
manifest.scope: Paired development comparison on the previous eight cases; single observation per variant, no held-out claim. Same low effort, model, transport and isolation; compact instruction and output differ.

limitations: Eight previously used development cases, one observation per variant; not a held-out or statistically reliable tail-latency estimate.
Both variants explicitly request low effort. Prior run did not capture effective effort; its 18.20 second p95 is not a controlled comparator.
Quality checks cover classification and requirement accounting, not generated objective-description quality.
Timing excludes thread startup. Relative improvement does not prove one-second feasibility.
No wrapper activation, timeout changes, durable integration, acceptance or publication.
